movesets.name: Specstrier
movesets.description:
Choice Specs helps Spectrier take full advantage of its phenomenal Special Attack stat by making sure it is able to repeatedly OHKO any Pokemon after they have been damaged by chip damage or entry hazards, allowing Spectrier to sweep easily with the assist of Grim Neigh. Shadow Ball destroys Ghost-types like Sinistcha and Gholdengo with ease and breaks bulky threats like Toxapex, Archaludon, and physically defensive Corviknight. Draining Kiss is a great coverage move for hitting Dark-types such as non-Choice Scarf Roaring Moon, Hydreigon, and non-Choice Scarf Meowscarada. With the help of status spreading from Gholdengo and Pecharunt, Hex effectively breaks Poison Heal Gliscor and decimates statused special walls like Clodsire and Articuno. Will-O-Wisp also burns Alolan Muk, Ting-Lu, and Hisuian Goodra to cripple them severely before breaking them despite the type resistances. Psychic can check Poison- and Fighting-types like Iron Moth, the aforementioned Clodsire, and defensive Great Tusk while also being the strongest move to threaten Normal-types. Hyper Beam cleanly OHKOes Ogerpon-H and Ogerpon-W after chip damage.

Physical Dragapult is a phenomenal teammate, pressuring foes that Spectrier struggles to break, such as Assault Vest Iron Hands, Hoopa-U, and Hisuian Goodra, all of which would otherwise threaten Spectrier in the long run. Choice Scarf Flutter Mane destroys Dark-types such as Roaring Moon and Choice Specs Dragapult with Moonblast while being able to use coverage options such as Thunderbolt to eliminate Barraskewda outside of rain. Swords Dance Hisuian Zoroark grants its allies an immunity to Ghost-type moves and can disguise itself as Spectrier with Illusion to trick opponents. After a foe fallsfor the bait, then threatens physically frail checks to Spectrier such as Ting-Lu, Blissey, and Heatran with a +2 Low Kick. Bulky Gholdengo can weaken numerous foes such as Garganacl and Alolan Muk that Spectrier can’t OHKO while also being able to absorb status moves from status spreaders using its infamous ability Good as Gold. Pecharunt pivots Spectrier in with Parting Shot to let it come in on a foe that it cannot beat while also checking physical attackers such as Azumarill with Malignant Chain. Brambleghast can set entry hazards to make it easier for Spectrier to KO its respective Fire-type checks in Heatran and opposing Ceruledge. Brambleghast can also act as a spinner to allow Spectrier safer entry from entry hazards. Focus Sash Ceruledge is an amazing physical wallbreaker that can easily set up a Swords Dance before attacking with its priority, picking off opposing Flutter Mane in the event of a Ghost mirror matchup. It's also a great check against Alolan Muk and Articuno, which can both be dangerous special walls if not handled quickly. Finally, Skeledirge not only checks Scizor, Lokix, and Weavile but also spreads Will-O-Wisp burns to Dragonite and Azumarill to guarantee a safer sweep late-game.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

Heavy-Duty Boots may be used if Brambleghast is not chosen as a teammate due to Spectrier's weakness to Toxic Spikes; however, Spectrier doesn't like losing passive recovery if using Substitute. Draining Kiss is an option over Substitute, hitting Dark- and Normal-types like Hydreigon, Darkrai, and Hisuian Zoroark, although Spectrier is susceptible to Toxic and revenge killing attempts without Substitute.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description:
Spectrier is a deadly special attacker that is able to quickly snowball against teams thanks to its high Speed, outrunning some of the metagame's fastest threats like Greninja and Iron Valiant. Spectrier utilizes Draining Kiss to hit Dark-type Pokemon that would otherwise resist its STAB Shadow Ball like the aforementioned Greninja as well as non-Choice Scarf Meowscarada and Roaring Moon. Draining Kiss also serves as a secondary recovery option to help heal off the damage taken by setting up a Substitute. Nasty Plot is used to elevate Spectrier's Special Attack to incredible heights without having to KO foes beforehand. Spectrier shines best when it is able to set up a Substitute, and subsequently a Nasty Plot, in the face of a more passive foe like Toxapex, then begin spamming its scarcely resisted Shadow Ball + Draining Kiss combination. Leftovers is used to provide more substantial recovery than Draining Kiss, but Colbur Berry is an option to take a Dark-type attack from Pokemon like Choice Scarf Great Tusk, Roaring Moon, and Barraskewda. Will-O-Wisp should be used instead of Substitute if Colbur Berry is the item of choice, as it allows Spectrier to capitalize on surviving an attack from these extremely potent physical threats. If Will-O-Wisp is preferred over Substitute, Hex can also be used to deal more damage to burned threats.

Skeledirge can switch into strong physical attacks from Pokemon that threaten Spectrier such as Choice Scarf Gallade, Scizor, Ceruledge, and Mimikyu lacking Shadow Claw, then scare them with Will-O-Wisp. Mimikyu is also a great teammate, as it can help Spectrier deal with Pokemon that may not go down to a single Draining Kiss, such as Ting-Lu, as well as Bisharp and Darkrai if Disguise is in tact. Mimikyu is also able to finish off threats such as Flutter Mane and Dragapult with Shadow Sneak. Froslass and Brambleghast are teammates that work well with Spectrier, setting up Spikes for Spectrier to nab easier KOs and snowball with Grim Neigh. Froslass is also able to use Thunder Wave to slow down faster Pokemon, while Brambleghast is able to remove entry hazards via Rapid Spin, allowing Spectrier to pivot more freely. Choice Scarf Flutter Mane is a great teammate thanks to its incredible Speed and ablility to deal with common Choice Scarf users that give Spectrier trouble such as Gholdengo, Hisuian Samurott and Great Tusk. STAB Moonblast can also damage or remove Dark-type Pokemon to make Spectrier's job easier. Finally, Hisuian Zoroark is a solid teammate due to its ability to switch into Ghost-type attacks that would otherwise threaten Spectrier and all of its other teammates. Hisuian Zoroark can also apply utility support by wearing down opposing teams with Will-O-Wisp and Knock Off. Dragapult is a great teammate, as it can burn and force damage on common walls like Quagsire, Clodsire, Alolan Muk and Ting-Lu, and forcing damage on them to make sweeping easier. It is also important to note that burned Quagsire and Clodsire cannot break Spectrier's Substitute in one hit, making setting up a lot easier. Finally, bulky Nasty Plot Gholdengo is a great teammate for Spectrier. Gholdengo can wear down Dark- and Poison-type Pokemon like Choice Scarf Meowscarada and Clodsire, which Spectrier struggles with, while Spectrier can help with faster threats like Dragon- and Fighting-type Pokemon, such as Hydreigon and Great Tusk.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Spectrier is an exceptional setup sweeper on Ghost teams due to its great Speed tier, incredible ability, and access to various utility options, allowing it to snowball through Poison, Ground, and Flying teams. Spectrier's combination of Calm Mind and Will-O-Wisp is notably important, as it allows Spectrier to be an annoyance to both physical and special attackers. Hex in conjunction with Will-O-Wisp deals immense damage versus threats like Corviknight, Toxapex, and Hisuian Goodra as well as takes advantage of Pokemon reliant on status ailments to function such as Poison Heal Gliscor and Guts Heracross. Substitute protects Spectrier from status ailments inflicted by passive Pokemon like Toxapex, Amoonguss, and Quagsire. Furthermore, Substitute provides more opportunities to set up Calm Mind boosts and denies the opponent of a chance to revenge kill Spectrier. The given EV spread allows Spectrier to outpace non-Choice Scarf Meowscarada, prevents Spectrier's Substitute from being broken by burned Assault Vest Iron Hands.

Choice Scarf Flutter Mane is incredibly valued as a teammate due to its ability to threaten Dark- and Dragon-type Pokemon like Choice Scarf Greninja, Galarian Moltres, and Choice Scarf Roaring Moon as well as faster Ghost-types such as Swift Swim Basculegion, Dragapult, and Choice Scarf Gholdengo. In return, Spectrier threatens special walls like Hisuian Goodra, Clodsire, and Gliscor. Focus Sash Ceruledge threatens special walls like Articuno and Heatran as well as takes on faster Ghost-types such as Flutter Mane and Dragapult with Shadow Sneak, appreciating Spectrier's ability to burn walls. Air Balloon Gholdengo is a great asset in the Fairy and Ice matchups, beating Pokemon like Iron Valiant, Kyurem, and Alolan Ninetales as well as Ursaluna and Empoleon. Hex Dragapult spreads even more status ailments to set up Spectrier for success late-game and threatens Kommo-o, Hydreigon, and Kyurem. Additionally, Choice Band Dragapult 2HKOes Alolan Muk with Dragon Darts, threatens opposing Dragapult and Choice Scarf Gholdengo with Sucker Punch, and OHKOes Hoopa-U with U-turn, also offering pivoting. Choice Scarf Dragapult also provides U-turn and can outpace Choice Scarf users like Roaring Moon and Walking Wake. Brambleghast and Froslass wear down defensive switch-ins such as Heatran, Ting-Lu, and Alolan Muk with Spikes, while Brambleghast also removes Toxic Spikes using Rapid Spin. Hisuian Zoroark offers a Ghost-type immunity and can spread burn with Will-O-Wisp, easing Spectrier's time setting up. Skeledirge checks Ogerpon-H, Choice Scarf Infernape, and Heatran using Earth Power and takes on setup sweepers such as Volcarona and Frosmoth. Mimikyu checks Dark-types like Hoopa-U, Choice Scarf Meowscarada, and Hydreigon while also offering a one-time check to Weavile, Greninja, and Bisharp due to Disguise. Sinistcha beats Water-types like Barraskewda and Urshifu-R as well as Ground-types such as Ursaluna and Landorus. Gengar offers Toxic Spikes to accumulate chip damage via Spectrier's Substitute and enhance the power of Hex.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description: The Special Defense allows Spectrier to survive Gholdengo's Shadow Ball or Torkoal's Eruption. The Special Attack investment allows it to OHKO zero bulk Ogerpon Formes with a Nasty Plot boost, and the speed investment lets it outspeed Adamant Chien-Pao.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Early round 1 onwards

Price Range: Banned or 19 points

Overview: Spectrier is an incredibly powerful wallbreaker and sweeper that can quickly snowball out of control with its ability, Grim Neigh. Although it lacks coverage, its huge Special Attack and Speed stats along with its support moves make up for it, leaving it very difficult to check properly, and Draining Kiss can keep it healthy and defeat Dark-types that normally check it. Spectrier requires very little support to work properly, typically just needing a Fighting-type teammate or entry hazard support to break through its checks, which makes it one of the best Pokemon available. In formats with rosters of 8 Pokemon, Spectrier is almost always banned because it forces a lot of preparation, making it very difficult for opponents to check it with limited options.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Late-game Sweeper: Spectrier can easily win games by setting up with Nasty Plot or Calm Mind and snowballing with Grim Neigh. Shadow Ball allows for immediate damage, while Draining Kiss can keep it healthy and beat Dark-types, especially after a Special Attack boost. If needed, Spectrier can also boost its Speed with Agility and stop foes from disrupting it with Taunt.

Wallbreaker: With Choice Specs or another damage-boosting item combined with Nasty Plot, Spectrier can be an effective wallbreaker by dealing immediate damage to foes. This set can sweep late-game or break specific Pokemon to enable its teammates.

Status Spreader: Spectrier can use Will-O-Wisp to spread burn against its typical checks, enabling its teammates down the line or dealing large amounts of damage itself with Hex.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Shadow Ball, Hex

Setup Moves: Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, Agility

Utility Moves: Taunt, Will-O-Wisp, Substitute, Disable

Coverage: Draining Kiss, Dark Pulse, Psychic, Mud Shot

Niche Moves

Endure: Endure can be combined with Salac Berry to give Spectrier an immediate Speed boost, allowing it to outspeed Choice Scarf revenge killers.

Snarl: Snarl can help Spectrier take hits more effectively from special attackers while also dealing a solid amount of damage. This can especially be helpful on Nasty Plot and utility sets.

Pain Split: While it is typically outclassed by Draining Kiss, Pain Split can be used against Pokemon with high HP that Spectrier typically struggles breaking to keep it healthy while dealing large amounts of damage.

Curse: Spectrier can use Curse on its checks to deal massive damage to them and force them out, letting it get free damage or setup opportunities.

Hyper Beam: Hyper Beam can be used as a nuke against foes that resist Spectrier's other attacks, especially on an all-out attacker set.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Heavy-Duty Boots is typically preferred on Spectrier, since it keeps it healthy against teams with entry hazard setters. It also negates Spectrier's weakness to Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web, which can shut it down.

Damage-boosting Items: Spectrier sometimes appreciates damage-boosting items, notably Choice Specs and Life Orb, to do extra damage to foes it would normally not be able to KO.

Leftovers: If entry hazards are not an issue, Leftovers synergizes well with Draining Kiss, keeping Spectrier as healthy as possible. This is appreciated even further on sets that carry Substitute.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries, especially Colbur Berry, give Spectrier more opportunities to attack and set up against its typical checks. Colbur Berry can also help Spectrier against revenge killers with Sucker Punch.

Niche Items

Sitrus Berry: Sitrus Berry is valuable against foes that barely 2HKO Spectrier, letting it take another hit, which can give it more attacking or setup opportunities.

Choice Scarf: Choice Scarf can be used to outspeed opposing revenge killers while still letting Spectrier snowball late-game with Grim Neigh.

Salac Berry: Combined with Endure or against specific attacks, Spectrier can gain an immediate Speed boost with Salac Berry, allowing it to outspeed faster revenge killers.

Lum Berry: Lum Berry allows Spectrier to get around typical status spreaders that would normally shut it down with poison or paralysis.

Tera

Spectrier's main issue is its lack of coverage, which makes it often struggle against bulky Dark- and Normal-types as well as specially defensive Pokemon. Tera allows Spectrier to get around that, which means that it is always Tera banned. It often appreciates Tera Fairy to boost Draining Kiss damage and give it a better defensive typing, though it can also benefit from specific Tera types such as Tera Fighting, Ice, and Ground for needed coverage through Tera Blast. It can also simply use Tera Ghost to make its STAB attacks even stronger, allowing it to break through specially defensive walls more effectively.

Draft Strategy

Spectrier is an incredibly fast and powerful Pokemon that forces a lot of opposing preparation. It appreciates a team that can support it well, but it also appreciates alternative potential wincons that can get overwhelming to prepare for alongside it.

Offensive Fighting-types: Offensive Fighting-types make incredible Spectrier partners, since they can handle the Dark- and Normal-types that typically check it. Since most get a form of pivoting, they can also easily pivot into Spectrier on anticipated switches, quickly putting opponents in a tough spot. Good partners include Urshifu-S, Sneasler, and Iron Hands.

Physical Wallbreakers: Spectrier forces Special Defense EV investment, so pairing it with strong physical wallbreakers like Meowscarada, Ogerpon-W, and Baxcalibur quickly overwhelms opponents with offensive pressure.

Entry Hazard Control: Spectrier appreciates entry hazard setters that can weaken its foes, such as Garchomp, Iron Treads, and Glimmora. Spectrier itself also plays as a great spinblocker that can easily switch in and immediately add offensive pressure. On the other hand, entry hazard removers like Terapagos, Great Tusk, and Corviknight help Spectrier, especially when it does not want to use Heavy-Duty Boots.

Dark-types: Dark-types pair well with Spectrier, as they can effectively cover its weaknesses and take hits from revenge killers. Bulky Dark-types that can take multiple hits such as Ting-Lu, Overqwil, and Darkrai are even more valuable.

Checks and Counters

Bulky Dark- and Normal-types: Although Spectrier has Draining Kiss, it often needs a bit of time to get going, so bulky Dark- and Normal-types like Ting-Lu, Ursaluna, and Kingambit can somewhat reliably check it.

Specially Defensive Pokemon: It is hard for Spectrier to initially break through many specially defensive Pokemon, even those that are neutral to Shadow Ball like Clodsire and Hisuian Goodra, making them solid checks. Although it can freely set up on many of them, it is weak to phazing and status, especially if it does not have Taunt or if its checks use a Mental Herb.

Fast Revenge Killers: Spectrier often forces revenge killers to handle it, since most defensive walls cannot reliably beat it. Choice Scarf or Booster Energy users like Iron Valiant, Meowscarada, and Urshifu-S are typically necessary, since very few Pokemon outspeed Spectrier naturally. Priority moves such as Palafin's Jet Punch and Kingambit's Sucker Punch can also effectively revenge kill Spectrier.

Status: Spectrier is very weak to status, especially paralysis, which allows most Pokemon to revenge kill it, and poison, which puts it on a timer. While Spectrier can use Taunt, Mental Herb can get around it, and Toxic Spikes can also be detrimental to it.

movesets.name: Life Orb
movesets.description:
• Being an extremely fast and powerful Ghost-type with access to Calm Mind and Will-O-Wisp, Spectrier is able to flexibly set up on many different attackers.
  • After a Will-O-Wisp, Hex is Spectrier's strongest Ghost-type move. The doubled Base Power of Hex allows Spectrier to remain advantaged in Calm Mind wars against Cresselia and Iron Crown and against burned Pokemon that would otherwise be able to KO Spectrier such as Annihilape and Metagross.
  • Hyper Beam allows Spectrier to OHKO frail Pokemon such as Meowscarada and Haxorus.
  • Calm Mind allows Spectrier to tank moves from strong special attackers such as non-Assault Vest Volcanion and KO back after one or two Calm Mind boosts with Hyper Beam.
  • The Speed EVs let Spectrier outspeed all Meowscarada sets, while the Special Attack EVs let it OHKO standard Haxorus with Hyper Beam. The rest of the EVs are placed in Defense for the best odds against Choice Scarf Haxorus.
  • Spectrier struggles to deal with Pokemon that do not mind being burned such as Guts Ursaluna and Hisuian Goodra, anti-setup Pokemon like Volcarona and Primarina, faster Pokemon that can OHKO it such as Chien-Pao and Dragapult, and Dark-type Pokemon such as Urshifu-S and Hoopa-U. Therefore, Pokemon like Primarina and Iron Valiant make great partners.
